Platinum Investing
Rarer than gold, with strong industrial demand from auto catalysts. Platinum trades on a different rhythm — here is the framework.
Platinum sits in an awkward middle ground for most investors: too industrial to behave like gold, too scarce and concentrated in supply to behave like a base metal. About 70% of mined supply comes from a handful of South African operations, and roughly 40% of annual demand is tied to autocatalysts. That combination produces price action that often diverges sharply from the rest of the precious-metals complex — and creates entry points that gold and silver investors routinely miss.
This path builds the working knowledge to evaluate platinum on its own terms rather than as a gold substitute. By the end, you will understand the supply pipeline, the demand drivers worth tracking, the practical tradeoffs between bullion, ETFs, mining equities, and futures, and how platinum fits inside a tax-aware long-term portfolio. The goal is competence: making allocation, vehicle, and timing decisions about platinum specifically — with reasons you can defend.
📊
What you'll learn
How South African supply concentration and autocatalyst demand drive the platinum price cycle
The real tradeoffs between physical bars and coins, ETFs, miner equities, and futures exposure
How to size a platinum position alongside gold and silver without doubling up on the same risk
Tax treatment, IRA eligibility rules, and storage choices that materially affect after-tax returns
What’s in this path

Introduction to Platinum Investing
Platinum is roughly 30 times rarer than gold and serves as both an industrial and precious metal, offering distinct diversification and supply-driven upside.
Platinum Market Fundamentals
How scarcity, concentrated supply, industrial demand, and persistent deficits shape platinum prices and create distinct dynamics from gold and silver.
Physical Platinum Investment
How to buy, store, and sell physical platinum bars and coins, including premiums, VAT impact, storage choices, and liquidity considerations.
Indirect Platinum Investment Methods
Survey of ETFs, mining stocks, futures, options, vaulted accounts, and funds that provide platinum exposure without holding the physical metal.
Comprehensive Platinum Investment Strategy
How to build a diversified platinum allocation across physical metal, ETFs, and mining stocks while managing volatility, costs, and geopolitical risk.
Advanced Platinum Investment Approaches
Sophisticated platinum strategies including vaulted ownership, derivatives, leveraged mining stocks, and ratio-based trades for experienced investors managing complex risk.
Platinum Tax & Retirement Planning
How platinum investments are taxed in the US, the role of self-directed IRAs, and strategies to optimize after-tax returns.
